query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS axis_source_nez (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  axis_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  source_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  confidence DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
  evidence TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_axis_source (axis_id, source_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (axis_id) REFERENCES research_axis_nez(axis_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES source_article_nez(source_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
